sites.title: Design System Strategy, Implementation & Training for Teams – Baseline Design
sites.description: Baseline helps teams build better design systems with strategy, implementation, and training across Figma, design tokens, governance, documentation, and the workflows that keep systems working.
sites.home_text:
Systems, strategy, and training for teams building what comes next. 
 Start a project 
A good design system makes better products possible, and makes the people building them quicker and more sure of their own decisions. 
We work on the foundations underneath: components and tokens, governance, the workflows that keep a system healthy, and the training that helps your team run it without us in the room. 
Systems are our thing, but people are the point. 
Every engagement mixes those differently, depending on where a team is in the life of their system. Some come to us with a library that needs restructuring. Some have the library already and need a team that knows how to run it. And some have a design system strategy question that has to be settled before any of the building makes sense.

Services 
We love big, ambitious projects. We work alongside teams on component architecture, token structure, governance, and the harder questions that come with a design system read by designers, engineers, and AI agents alike. That last group is new, and it raises the stakes on precise naming.
